name: Generate detailed fictional character profiles
description: Users asked to generate detailed character profiles, biographies, and personality descriptions for fictional, original, or reimagined figures across various fandoms and settings. The requests often included specific attributes such as appearance, backstory, abilities, and relationships, with some variations focusing on lists of supporting cast members, role-playing game sheets, or specific format templates.
